metadata.body:
Constrain advice bindings while using exact names for known library signatures. Akka/Pekko matching results, Vert.x HTTP responses, and Pulsar client and callback signatures no longer need hierarchy traversal. The existing Hibernate, Jersey, and Reactor Netty signature lists remain unchanged.

JMS consumers, HTTP-server contexts, and Lettuce builders check their known names first. A hierarchy fallback preserves compatible covariant signatures from custom implementations of those extensible APIs.

The regression tests cover supported concrete signatures and reject incompatible bindings. Reactor Netty coverage verifies its existing promise-name list rather than requiring arbitrary promise subtypes.

This is the signature-compatibility slice of #20475, independent of the binding-safety fixes in #20491.

Part of #20103.
